core_obligations.name: OVERLAY_PARAMETRIC_PARENT_CONGRUENCE
core_obligations.statement: For every lawful additional visible outer reservation overlay, inherited parent actions factor through the reserved parent skin with ID-free relative-scope labels and Counter multiplicity preserved.

core_obligations.name: VISIBLE_LEAF_RESERVATION_TRANSPORT
core_obligations.statement: Inherited actions preserve visible leaf occurrences or provide an equivariant quotient-visible transport that carries all outer reservations to successor leaves.

core_obligations.name: OUTER_GENERATOR_NATURALITY
core_obligations.statement: Outer legality, labels and quotient-visible successor read only hierarchical occurrence structure, paired typed (p,f), Bridge, scope and multiplicity. Hidden incidence writes are allowed; hidden incidence/topology/ancestry/provenance reads are forbidden.

core_obligations.name: EXHAUSTIVE_FINITE_ACTION_BASIS_AND_CLOSURE
core_obligations.statement: Every admitted action is covered by inherited transport or the outer generator; action copies are finite Counter data; labels are ID-free; generation is equivariant; exact successors remain in the quotient domain.

evidence_rule: A repeat level may inherit theorem conclusions only after its exact implementation/spec passes B1-B4 and S1-S4/reopen scans. A single existence witness proves nonemptiness only; it does not by itself prove historical graduation.
purpose: Apply the generic ownership-preserving recursive lift from O8 upward without repeating broad historical censuses. This is an application/audit gate; the frozen GRRL theorem authority remains separate.
reopen_conditions: new state field or relation arity

structural_grammar.statement: Outer relations are pairwise, join distinct top-owner occurrences, and reserve one compatible endpoint per side.
Forward relations are monotone additions with no deletion, rewiring, retagging, endpoint replacement, copying, multiway junction or feedback.
One mature O_(n+1) carrier is one finite nontrivial connected outer-owner component.
Ordinary one-cross same-level composition merges into one connected same-level carrier; the next scope begins only when complete same-level owners remain distinct under a retained outer relation.
